address.note: Council assessment report for DA/751/2019: 8 Grand Avenue, Lot 2 DP 1258587 (site since re-described as Lot 10 DP 1275083, shared with SY10x - SSD-53338465 report). The panel project listing gives '10 Grand Avenue' (source 10); Equinix/master.csv use 8A Grand Avenue.

lat.note: geocoded: NSW address point for 8A Grand Avenue (eastern part of the 8 Grand Ave site; SY10 occupies the western part). Previous value -33.82198,151.03614 was the 10 Grand Avenue address point, which is now a separate property.

builder.note: Head contractor per MBC Group (principal certifier) project page.

developer.value: Equinix Australia Pty Ltd (landowner); owned by Equinix/PGIM Real Estate xScale JV
developer.note: DA applicant Greenbox Architecture Pty Ltd c/- Mecone; owner Equinix Australia Pty Ltd. JV closed Mar 2022, PGIM 80% / Equinix 20% (source 6); Equinix operates.

mw_it.note: 'More than 28 MW' power capacity at full build; >14 MW at opening (Jun 2022). Equinix states 'power capacity' - may not be strictly IT load. datacenters.com lists 24 MW.

cost_aud_m.note: Council-accepted genuine cost of development $49,242,580 (independent QS review) for DA/751/2019 (Stage 1 + Stage 2 concept). Applicant QS estimate / panel-listed CIV $44,717,186 (source 10). JV headline US$575m covers SY9x and SY10x.

authority.value: Sydney Central City Planning Panel (City of Parramatta DA)

pathway.note: Staged DA: Stage 1 3-storey data centre, concept approval for Stage 2 building. Modified as DA/751/2019/C (PPSSCC-308, 2022, source 5).

lodged.note: also 'Date of DA lodgement 23 December 2019' in council assessment report

determined.note: approved, unanimous (papers circulated 24-31 Jul 2020); also confirmed by SSD-53338465 assessment report

jobs_operational.note: Council assessment report: stage 1 building 'will generate the following on a daily basis: 30 full-time equivalent staff, 20 maintenance/security staff' (plus 15 customers). SSD-53338465 report likewise gives 'the existing SY9 facility seeing the equivalent of 50'.

construction_start.note: MBC Group: construction 'due to commence late 2020' (planned)

construction_end.note: Opened 13 Jun 2022 with >14 MW (first phase); further fit-out to 28 MW
